Beyond the impact in the UK—which will be glorious—it’s yet another sign that the New Fusion of conservatism, populism, and nationalism is, in fact, the way. 

What a wonderful time to be alive.

Mass-migration has overrun the trucking industry and has made our roadways less safe.

It’s time to end mass-migration.
It's time to mass-deport illegal aliens.
We must put the American people first.

Last night’s Indiana primary elections should give conservatives hope that we can remove politicians who talk like conservatives but ultimately aid the Left. They also serve as a warning that Americans are paying attention and will not reward failure. If you campaigned as a conservative, deliver on what you were elected for or pack your bags.


Andrew Kolvet (@AndrewKolvet)

Already 6 targeted Indiana State Senate races have been called in favor of grassroots candidates over the establishment Rs

Yet another example of why we shouldn’t listen to the DC consultant class.


Greg Price (@greg_price11)

Internet: 'MAGA is dead.'

Real life: Six Republican incumbents in the Indiana Senate lose because they were primaried by President Trump.

Now, they’re coming alongside the U.S. as partners.

Last week, the U.S. national debt crossed 100% of GDP, yet Congress is unwilling to make any spending reforms in the upcoming reconciliation bill—a major missed opportunity.
